applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term, audit job number and audit type (final, interim, revision, non-compliant)
Each GL exposure: class code, location/state, basis type (payroll, sales, area, units), estimated and audited basis
Whether Products-Completed Operations applies; limits (each occurrence / aggregate)
Expected premium and direction vs premium shown
Mid-term changes (class added/removed, location or limit change) and dates; keyed by auditor or automation; screenshots
title: Automated GL audit creates premium or a credit with no change
symptoms: Automated GL audit line generates unexpected premium
GL audit term shows a credit with no change made
cause: The automated audit batch defaults audited basis from the estimate and re-rates every exposure. If GL rates, ILF or rounding changed since issue, a minimum premium applies, or 'if any' classes are defaulted, a delta appears with no basis change.
diagnosis: Compare estimated vs audited basis on each exposure of the automated line
Check whether GL rates or ILF changed during the term
Check the automated audit job definition (T0095 change)
resolution: Reverse the automated audit line and reopen it for the auditor to enter
workaround: Suspend auto-initiation for the affected class codes.
permanent_fix: Idempotent trigger: no line until the audited basis differs from the estimate; do not re-rate unchanged exposures (T0095).
escalation: PC L3 Rating & Audit; Sev 2 if producing premium in bulk.
